question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.**

Genuine
solution:
The correct answer is "Authentic."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Genuine"** means real; true. (वास्‍तविक; असली)

 
 
• **Example**: *He thought that he had bought a **genuine**__ Rolex watch but it was a cheap fake.*
 
 
 
• ​The synonym of "Genuine" is "Authentic."
 
• The word "Authentic" means that you know is real or genuine. (प्रामाणिक, असली)
 __
 
• Example:* She served me an authentic__ Italian dish.*
 
 
 
• ​So, the correct answer is Option 1.**
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** 

 
• Deceptive: **likely to give a false impression or to make somebody believe something that is not true. (छलपूर्ण, भ्रमामक, धोखा देने वाला)
 
• **Fabricated: **to invent something false in order to deceive people. (मनगढ़ंत बातें करना, झूठी बातें गढ़ना, विरचना करना)
 
• **Erroneous: **not correct; based on wrong information. (अशुद्घ; ग़लत सूचना पर आधारित)
